name: [👹] Bir Solitaktak Çal
desc:
🗣️ Welcome to Steal a Bekoceybabapro!

🔥 Collect unique Brainrots, grow your collection, earn cash, and become the richest player in the server!

⭐ How to Play

👽 Buy a Brainrot and place it in your base.
💸 Earn cash over time to unlock even more Brainrots.
🐦‍🔥 Rebirth to gain permanent boosts and progress faster.
✋ Buy Slaps and fun Troll Gear to surprise other players!

 🌍 Supported Devices

💻 PC/Desktop
📱 Mobile
📲 Tablet

👍 Like the game and join the group for updates and future rewards!

🙏 Special thanks to @rubloxgeldikacin for helping develop the game.
🙏 Special thanks to @TAR1K_785 for helping create the game's sounds.

🎉 Have fun, build the best collection, and reach the top!
